mapper.insert: INSERT INTO health_record (user_id, systolic, diastolic, blood_sugar, heart_rate, weight, bmi, memo, recorded_at, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{systolic}, #{diastolic}, #{bloodSugar}, #{heartRate}, #{weight}, #{bmi}, #{memo}, #{recordedAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, systolic, diastolic, blood_sugar, heart_rate, weight, bmi, memo, recorded_at, create_time, update_time FROM health_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC
SELECT id, user_id, systolic, diastolic, blood_sugar, heart_rate, weight, bmi, memo, recorded_at, create_time, update_time FROM health_record WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE health_record SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(recorded_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, AVG(systolic) AS avg_systolic, MAX(systolic) AS max_systolic, MIN(systolic) AS min_systolic, AVG(diastolic) AS avg_diastolic, MAX(diastolic) AS max_diastolic, MIN(diastolic) AS min_diastolic, AVG(blood_sugar) AS avg_blood_sugar, MAX(blood_sugar) AS max_blood_sugar, MIN(blood_sugar) AS min_blood_sugar, AVG(heart_rate) AS avg_heart_rate, MAX(heart_rate) AS max_heart_rate, MIN(heart_rate) AS min_heart_rate, AVG(bmi) AS avg_bmi, MAX(bmi) AS max_bmi, MIN(bmi) AS min_bmi FROM health_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND recorded_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{monthCount} MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(recorded_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM health_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
